notes: renderer=skia-software; unthrottled_redraw=true; frame_ms = interval between consecutive frame ends; frame end = first winit about_to_wait after a RedrawRequested (Slint renders and presents synchronously while handling RedrawRequested: softbuffer present_with_damage for software/skia-software, eglSwapBuffers for femtovg), observed through the public slint::winit_030::CustomApplicationHandler; set_rendering_notifier is not usable as frame end (AfterRendering fires before present, and the software renderer returns Unsupported). continuous redraw requested from about_to_wait via WinitWindowAccessor::with_winit_window(|w| w.request_redraw()), which bypasses Slint's internal X11 TimerBasedFrameThrottle (60 Hz timer) using public documented APIs only (feature unstable-winit-030) ; 2 s warm-up not recorded. 3 screens as Rectangles whose x has animate 300ms ease-in-out; modal opacity animate 200ms; sequence cycle push,push,modal-open,modal-close,pop,pop at one step per 300ms; transitions_done counts steps whose animation window elapsed; one background thread burns a core
